title: InfoTooltip
wrapsNative: MonarchPopover (a Compose Popup) anchored to a MonarchIconButton, opened by its onClick
summary: The small info button next to a label that opens a short explanation is a MonarchPopover anchored to a MonarchIconButton, shown when the button is tapped and kept until the person taps elsewhere. Monarch ships no separate type.
whenToUse: Next to a field label or a metric whose meaning needs a sentence or two, such as how a score is calculated.
whenNotToUse: For text the person needs to fill in a field, use the field's helper text, which is always visible. For a name of an icon button, use a PlainTooltip (see tooltip). For interactive content such as a form, use MonarchPopover.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPopover(expanded: Boolean, onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, side: MonarchPopoverSide = MonarchPopoverSide.Bottom, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchIconButton(label: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, loadingLabel: String? = null, shape: Shape? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, icon: @Composable () -> Unit)

states.name: closed
states.description: Only the info button is shown, in the default icon color.

states.name: open
states.description: A tap shows the rich tooltip above the button, with a title and the explanation; with isPersistent it stays until a tap outside or back.

states.name: long press
states.description: Only a tap opens it; there is no hover on touch screens, and a long press is left to the system.

appearance: The popover on the raised surface with a hairline border and the presented shadow, the title in the default text color and the explanation in the muted text color. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web InfoTooltip is a toggletip on Popover that keeps focus on the button and copies its text into a live region. On Android the toggletip is a MonarchPopover opened from the button's onClick: it takes focus, so TalkBack moves into it, announces its label and returns to the button when it closes. The web's side becomes MonarchPopoverSide; the popover moves to the other side when there is no room. Monarch bundles no icons, so the info glyph comes from the app (the example uses SampleIcons.Info). The parity map named the native tooltip, and iOS builds a MonarchInfoTooltip on its popover; Android needs no wrapper because MonarchPopover already has the anchored, dismissible, rich form.
accessibility: The button is a MonarchIconButton with a 48dp touch target and a content description that names what it explains, such as "About visibility score".
With focusable = true the tooltip takes focus when it opens, so TalkBack reads the title and the explanation; back or a tap outside closes it.
The popover takes focus when it opens, so TalkBack reads its label and content and returns to the button when it closes.
The explanation wraps within the tooltip's maximum width at large font sizes.
edgeCases: Use one rememberTooltipState per button; tooltips share a MutatorMutex, so opening one closes another.
Keep the explanation short; a tooltip that needs scrolling should be a sheet or a help screen.
